title: Words as performance
when: The delivery of a memorable line is central to the clip.
story: Hook, context, contrast and the line worth remembering.
picture: Measured kinetic type, speaker tags, a meter and an occasional literal drawing.
pace: Follow vocal emphasis and silence; never add words or compress audio to fit the preset.
rules: Use measured word timings bound to the current recording.
Use text as picture selectively; give concrete ideas a scene.
